subject: Renewal uplift: inventory, legal evidence, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@marketly.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal uplift: inventory, legal evidence, and QBR scheduling

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. Per our conversation, Marketly is evaluating a term uplift and a 30% capacity increase for H1 2029 to support the new ingestion pipeline. I wanted to kick off a short renewal-orchestration thread so we have a clear inventory, timeline, and owner map to share with your procurement and security teams.

High-level ask / outcomes for this thread:
- Confirm target term and effective date (proposed start: 2029-01-01).
- Share legal/finance contacts and any contracting constraints.
- Provide security evidence required for procurement (SOC2 scope, data retention policy, audit window).
- Schedule a 60-minute QBR during the week of Oct 23 to surface staffing and migration runbook.

Suggested next steps: 
1) Please confirm whether Marketly will proceed with a 12-month term with the 30% capacity uplift or if you prefer a stair-step commitment.
2) Anton/Elena — can you share the procurement and security contact emails so we can circulate the Mutual Action Plan (attached)?
3) I'll loop in Redwood SRE for a short readiness readout after the QBR.

Candidate QBR windows (Pacific time):
- Tue Oct 24: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed Oct 25: 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00 PT

Attachments: Mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_Marketly.xlsx) and SOC2 evidence summary (SOC2-Summary-Marketly-Req.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_Marketly.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: SOC2-Summary-Marketly-Req.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@marketly.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anton Mejia <anton.mejia@marketly.com>
Date: 2028-10-04T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift: inventory, legal evidence, and QBR scheduling

Thanks Kimberly — this is great and aligns with what I briefed Anton on. Quick answers below: 

- Marketly prefers a 12-month term starting 2029-01-01 with the 30% uplift; we may revisit in Q2 for additional headroom.
- Procurement contact: Anton Mejia (anton.mejia@marketly.com).
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 Type II in-scope documents, data retention summary, and details on network isolation for private deployments.

For QBR, Oct 25 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our engineering and procurement teams.

I’ll ask Anton to share any contracting constraints (e.g., PO-only billing cadence) and loop in our legal if anything else is needed.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of ML Ops | Marketly
elena@marketly.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift: inventory, legal evidence, and QBR scheduling

Kim / team — thanks for the heads-up. A couple internal notes and readiness items before the QBR: 

- David: can you prepare a short capacity delta doc (current committed throughput, 30% uplift impact, estimated GPU hours and cost delta) — 1 pager.
- Connor: please draft a migration/readiness runbook outline we can show during the QBR (prefix caching, KV warm-up steps, expected warm-up time per pod).
- I’ll own the Mutual Action Plan review and legal checkpoint with procurement; I’ll also validate the DocuSign flow and whether Marketly needs a countersigned PO first.

Also adding two ops-level checklist items for the evidence packet: 
- Export of audit log retention policy and sample logs (redact PII).
- Network topology diagram for Dedicated / Private options.

If the external team confirms Oct 25 14:00 PT, I’ll block the slot and create an invite with a 30-minute pre-read package.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Renewal Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@marketly.com>, Anton Mejia <anton.mejia@marketly.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-11T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift: inventory, legal evidence, and QBR scheduling

Appreciate the quick responses — locking in actions and next steps below.

Confirmed:
- Term: 12 months starting 2029-01-01 with 30% capacity uplift.
- QBR: Wed Oct 25 14:00–15:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Deliverables and owners (pre-read due Oct 20):
- Mutual Action Plan (Marissa) — attachment circulated; Marissa will highlight any legal caveats.
- Capacity delta one-pager (David) — includes estimated GPU hours and cost delta.
- Migration runbook outline (Connor) — ops milestones and rollback criteria.
- Security evidence packet (Marissa + Connor) — SOC2 summary (we provided the stub), retention policy export, network topology.

Anton — please confirm whether Marketly requires PO-only billing or countersign-first for contracts so we can have legal prepare the right DocuSign flow. If you can drop that confirmation in the thread by Friday Oct 13, that’ll let us finalize DocuSign and billing terms.

Attachments included again for visibility: mutual_action_plan_Marketly.xlsx; SOC2-Summary-Marketly-Req.pdf.

Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up with the invite and a 30-minute pre-read thread (deadline Oct 20).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_Marketly.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: SOC2-Summary-Marketly-Req.pdf (pdf stub)
